items.title: Stella Oliver Interview, 1959-04-22
items.q: And we met when we was in New Orleans working. We met... He was working two doors from me, where I work.

ctx.x: Eighty-five. Eighty-five. Eighty-five. Eighty-five. I'm just a few years younger than Joe. And we met when we was in New Orleans working. We met... He was working two doors from me, where I work. And he was working for some Jewish family. They raised him. He was there as a boy. He didn't know much about Conrad, but he was determined to learn. So he started rehearsing, practicing, and he did fairly well.
Do you know when he moved to the city? Did he tell you when he moved?
